translation: Took place in posad Serock, [unclear: 17/18] September 1890, 7 PM. Appeared personally Moszek Zylbersztejn, trader, 33, and [unclear: Berek] Kołtun, cemetery attendant, 65, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 4 AM died an infant of male sex named Majer [unclear: Szapsa] Mendzilewski, two months of age, son of Szaja and Dwojra, the Mendzilewski spouses. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Majer [unclear: Szapsa] Mendzilewski this act was read to the witnesses, signed by us and one witness; the second witness is illiterate.
